[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Lemon Garlic Chicken Breast with Quinoa and Broccoli: Marinate chicken breast in lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil, then grill or bake. Serve with quinoa and steamed broccoli.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chicken Fajitas with Avocado Salsa: Sauté diced chicken breast with bell peppers, onions, and fajita seasoning. Serve with whole wheat tortillas, avocado salsa, and brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Chicken and Mushroom Creamy Pasta: Cook chicken breast with mushrooms, garlic, and onions in a creamy sauce made with Greek yogurt and parmesan cheese. Serve with whole wheat pasta and a side salad.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Korean-Style Chicken Breast with Gochujang Glaze: Marinate chicken breast in a spicy gochujang glaze, then grill or bake. Serve with roasted vegetables and brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Chicken and Spinach Stuffed Bell Peppers: Stuff bell peppers with cooked chicken breast, spinach, feta cheese, and quinoa, and bake until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of salmon recipes, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Grilled Salmon with Lemon Dill Sauce and Roasted Asparagus: Grill salmon fillets and serve with lemon dill sauce and roasted asparagus.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Baked Salmon with Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl: Season salmon fillets with cumin and chili powder, then bake. Serve with quinoa and black bean bowl, topped with avocado and salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Salmon and Avocado Sushi Rolls: Make sushi with salmon sashimi, avocado, and cucumber, wrapped in whole wheat nori seaweed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Salmon and Spinach Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms: Fill Portobello mushroom caps with cooked salmon, spinach, and feta cheese, and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Pan-Seared Salmon with Capers and Brown Rice: Pan-sear salmon fillets with capers, garlic, and lemon, and serve with brown rice and steamed green beans.
